about: Dungeon Master's Guide (2024): mechanics only, in askdnd's own words; never book text

entries.name: Dust of Sneezing and Choking
entries.why: You and every creature in a 30-foot Emanation make a DC 15 Constitution save (2024 DMG)

use.says: you and every creature within 30 feet; on a failure, Incapacitated and suffocating, repeating the save at the end of each turn

entries.name: Executioner's Axe
entries.why: an extra 2d6 Slashing against a Humanoid, and that much Temporary Hit Points for you

entries.name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
entries.why: Spend 1 charge to throw it (20/60 ft); on a hit, the target and creatures within 30 feet make a DC 17 Constitution save (2024 DMG)

use.says: thrown: range 20/60 ft; it flies back to your hand

rider.name: Thunderclap
rider.says: the target and every creature within 30 feet of it other than you: Stunned until the end of your next turn on a failure

entries.name: Hat of Wizardry
entries.why: Unknown Spell: a DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check to cast a Wizard cantrip you don't know (2024 DMG)

use.says: on a success you cast the cantrip; on a failure the action is wasted

entries.name: Keoghtom's Ointment
entries.why: a dose heals 2d8 + 2 (the jar's 1d4 + 1 doses are counted when it's found)

entries.name: Necklace of Prayer Beads
entries.why: Each bead casts its spell as a Bonus Action with your spell save DC, once until the next dawn; the DM sets the beads (2024 DMG)

entries.name: Potion of Fire Breath
entries.why: after drinking, a Bonus Action exhale (up to three times in an hour): Dex save DC 13, 4d6 Fire, half on a success

entries.name: Thunderous Greatclub
entries.why: an extra 1d8 Thunder to any creature it hits
